channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Thunderstorm warning issued for 10 states until 5pm
item.description: MetMalaysia warns of thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds across 10 states and several Sarawak divisions until late afternoon today.

item.title: TTDI resident complains about 3-hour fireworks — Malaysians fire back: “It’s once a year, chill!”
item.description: TTDI resident complains about 3-hour fireworks, sparking online backlash as Malaysians defend festive noise and urge tolerance.

item.title: Hyatt executive chairman resigns over Jeffrey Epstein email ties
item.description: Thomas Pritzker steps down as Hyatt's executive chairman following the release of emails showing his contact with the convicted sex offender.

item.title: Five arrested for alleged cockfighting activity in Kuching
item.description: Police raid uncovers alleged cockfighting in Sungai Apong, Kuching, leading to five arrests on Sunday

item.title: Logan Paul’s rare Pokemon card fetches record $16.5 million
item.description: An ultra-rare Pokemon card owned by YouTuber Logan Paul sold for a record $16.5 million at auction, certified as the world's most expensive trading card.

item.title: At least 14 killed in bomb and gun attacks in northwest Pakistan
item.description: A series of attacks in northwest Pakistan killed at least 14 people, including security forces and civilians, as militants target police and Chinese interests.

item.title: Bangladesh’s new parliament sworn in as Tarique Rahman set to lead
item.description: Tarique Rahman and lawmakers sworn in, marking a new era for Bangladesh after 2024 uprising and setting stage for his prime ministerial appointment.

item.title: Russia repels over 150 Ukrainian drones in overnight assault
item.description: Russian air defences intercepted a major Ukrainian drone attack ahead of new Geneva peace talks, with one child reported wounded in Crimea.
